catalog.container_strategy: Build the CPU LLVM backend and Python APIs in a dedicated dev environment; export precompiled modules and only the required TVM runtime to target. Use deterministic synthetic tensor inputs without downloading model weights.
catalog.purpose: TensorIR, compiler scheduling and MetaSchedule-style search research for CPU tensor kernels and explicitly admitted graphs.
qualification_gaps: The root archive excludes recursive dependencies, including FFI/runtime components and optional code generators; freeze the selected closure.
LLVM, Python, framework importer and runtime serialization compatibility need joint qualification.
Tensor scheduling experiments are a separate workload domain, not automatic evidence of general C/C++ compiler quality.
